translations.web: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.
translations.bsb: Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
translations.kjv: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
